pages.raw_meta: Reinventing home audio for today and tomorrow.
raw_blocks: At Sonos, we have a vision for sound
Sonos is a leading audio technology company that revolutionizes how people listen and connect to sound.

Since inventing wireless multiroom audio, we've continued innovating, creating wireless speakers, home theater systems, headphones, architectural components, and whole home audio solutions that have defined categories, pushed the boundaries of what's possible, and delighted listeners all around the world.

Sonos is a leading audio technology company that revolutionizes how people listen and connect to sound. Since inventing wireless multiroom audio, we've continued innovating, creating wireless speakers, home theater systems, headphones, architectural components, and whole home audio solutions that have defined categories, pushed the boundaries of what's possible, and delighted listeners all around the world.
The year was 2002. No one had heard of music streaming. Listening all around the home meant cranking the volume or setting up a complex stack of hardware and running cables through every wall.
But by the beaches of Santa Barbara, California, four music-loving engineers recognized the potential of home networking and set out with a simple goal: Make it easy to play any song in any room.
A track record of innovation
While Sonos has become synonymous with multiroom home audio, our patent portfolio boasts thousands of technologies that have forever changed how people listen.
Sonos Pro transforms the commercial audio market, giving business owners an innovative solution for remotely monitoring and managing music across multiple locations.
Sonos Ace headphones deliver a revolutionary personal surround sound experience with TV Audio Swap.
Sonos patents a solution for syncing wireless audio across multiple devices.
All-in-one speakers make wireless home audio more accessible than ever.
Ability to configure matching speakers as a Stereo Pair so they can bond together, providing a wider stereo experience.
“It’s an artistic approach to sound.”
Grammy-Winning Music Producer & Sonos Sound Experience Leader

The Sonos Soundboard includes some of the most discerning ears in the audio industry. These Oscar and GRAMMY Award-winning producers, mixers, artists, and engineers fine-tune our products to deliver sound exactly the way creators intended. You don't just hear every detail. You feel all the emotion.
Your browser cannot play the provided video file.

Through initiatives like hack week and experiment labs, we foster a culture of continuous improvement and creativity. Our commitment to global inclusion, belonging, and sustainability ensures we realize the future we envision.
